subject: Client Ops Coupling & MAP — milestones, owners, go/no-go dates
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Sasha Cole <sasha@greengrid.com>, Oliver Tan <oliver.tan@greengrid.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 5 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Client Ops Coupling & MAP — milestones, owners, go/no-go dates

Hi Sasha / Oliver —

Thanks again for the kickoff yesterday. Attached is our first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP-v1.xlsx) and a working SOW draft (SOW-draft-ggs.pdf) so we can align milestones and clear owners. High level ask: please review the milestones in the MAP and confirm any internal constraints that would push the proposed go/no-go checks.

Key proposed milestones (high-level):
- Discovery complete (data access + schema): target 2027-06-02 — Owner: GreenGrid (Sasha) / Redwood technical: Monica
- Integration prototype (API auth, prefix caching): target 2027-06-23 — Owner: Redwood Eng (Priyom)
- Staging validation (sensitivity tests + perf): target 2027-07-14 — Owner: GreenGrid Ops / Redwood QA
- Go/No-Go review & sign-off: target 2027-07-21 — Owners: GreenGrid exec + Redwood Customer Success

Please flag any blockers and/or alternate dates by EOD Friday 5/7 so we can incorporate into the MAP and finalize a meeting cadence. I proposed a 30-minute sync next Tuesday 5/11 at 10am PT; can you confirm?

Attachments: MAP-v1.xlsx (draft action grid), SOW-draft-ggs.pdf (working legal language)

Thanks —
Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Director, Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference

From: Sasha Cole <sasha@greengrid.com>

Cc: Oliver Tan <oliver.tan@greengrid.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 5 May 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Client Ops Coupling & MAP — milestones, owners, go/no-go dates

Rishi —

Thanks for the clear draft. We looked it over with the Ops team this morning. A couple of calls out:
1) Data discovery: we can meet the 6/2 milestone for schema access, but our security review (3rd-party ingestion) won't be complete until 6/9. We recommend moving the Discovery complete checkpoint to 6/09 to be safe.
2) Staging validation: our infra team has a scheduled maintenance window 7/11–7/12 which may affect the perf validation results; can we plan the validation window for 7/15–7/16 instead of the single date listed?

We also want to include our SRE lead (Oliver) as the technical approver for the integration prototype and staging validation — he is looped above.

If you can update the MAP with those date shifts and add an item for the security evidence packet (SOC 2 artifact + data retention summary), we can sign off faster. I'm available for the 5/11 10am PT slot.

Regards,
Sasha Cole
Head of Operations — GreenGrid Solutions
sasha@greengrid.com | +1 (206) 555-0123

Attachment: none

Subject: Re: Client Ops Coupling & MAP — milestones, owners, go/no-go dates

Sasha / team —

Appreciate the quick review and the maintenance window heads-up. I've updated the internal owner assignments and shifted the discovery and staging validation windows in the updated MAP (see attached architecture-diagram.png + I dropped a new MAP v1.1 into the shared Drive link). Summary of changes we will commit to internally:
- Discovery complete: moved to 2027-06-09 (GreenGrid sign-off) — Redwood lead: Monica Patel
- Integration prototype: target 2027-06-30 (to give Priyom two extra days after discovery closes) — Redwood Eng: Priyom Das
- Staging validation: validation window 2027-07-15 to 2027-07-16 (we will run perf jobs across both days) — Joint owners: GreenGrid SRE (Oliver) + Redwood QA
- Go/No-Go review: tentatively 2027-07-22 (to allow 1 business day after validation window) — Approval owners noted in MAP

Action items I added to the MAP: security evidence packet (SOC 2 summary + retention policy table) — Sasha, if you can share the SOC 2 evidence link (or a contact) ahead of 6/9 that would help our QA compliance checks.

Attachments: architecture-diagram.png (integration sketch)

Monica

Team —

Thanks — MAP v1.1 looks good from an engineering standpoint. We can absorb the extra week on discovery and shift the integration prototype to 6/30 as Monica proposed. Priyom notes:
- Redwood engineering will prioritize the API auth + kv-cache stub by 6/16 to start early integration tests.
- We'll provide a perf-run checklist and payload samples by 6/25 for GreenGrid to use in staging validation.

Next steps:
1) Rishi to publish MAP v1.1 and SOW-redlines (I attached a quick redline PDF with minor legal clarifications) into the HubSpot deal record.
2) Sasha to share SOC 2 evidence link or contact before 6/9.
3) Schedule the 5/11 alignment call at 10am PT — Rishi, please send the calendar invite and proposed agenda (20m alignment + 10m Q&A).
4) We will queue DocuSign for the SOW after the 7/22 Go/No-Go sign-off; tentative DocuSign envelope link will be added to the HubSpot deal when ready.

Attachments: SOW-redlines-ggs.pdf (annotated redlines)

See you on 5/11 —
